test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Mahatma Gandhi called a halt to the Non-Cooperation Movement after the Chauri Chaura incident. Where among the following places is Chauri Chaura located?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Gorakhpur.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chauri Chaura** is located in **Gorakhpur district **of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The incident took place on **February 4, 1922**.
 
• It was a violent clash in which led to **death of 22 policemen.**
 
• The clash was led the leader **Bhagwan din Aihir.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Non-Cooperation Movement, initiated by Mahatma Gandhi in 1920 **against Rowlatt Act (1919), Jallianwala Bagh Massacre (1919), Khilafat Movement (1919-1922).**
 
• it was done by **Boycotting of British Goods, Resignation from Government Employment, Boycott of British Educational Institutions and Law Courts, Refusal to Pay Taxes.**
 
• Gandhiji held into **jail for 6 months** after call off the movement.
 
• The Non-Cooperation Movement led the breeding ground and clear the vision for future National movements.
